newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy government studying latest petrol price rise.
newsitem.headline: Italy government studying latest petrol price rise.

text.p: The Italian government is examining a latest round of petrol price increases which has pushed unleaded petrol to record highs at the pumps, Industry Minister Pierluigi Bersani said on Friday.
Distribution firms on Thursday and Friday upped the price of a litre of unleaded petrol by around 10 lire to a maximum of 1,925 lire.
"We are looking into this and will compare it to the international situation to find the exact motivation behind behind this increase," Bersani said.

Petrol firms have blamed dollar strength for the price rises. Bersani agreed that the dollar might have hurt prices, but added that structural flaws with Italy's petrol distribution system might be adding to the strain.
"We are examining...this and will make some proposals," Bersani said. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
